1.title: House Bipartisan Task Force Outlines Need for Accountability, Transparency
1.description: The Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump is the official bipartisan body of the U.S. House of Representatives tasked with investigating the assassination attempts on the President-elect in Butler, Pa., and West Palm Beach, Fla. In its final report, submitted to Congress in December 2024, the Task Force highlighted the lack of accountability from federal agencies. The Secret Service, assigned a "no-fail" mission, failed in its duties. To restore the American people's trust in the safety of their elected officials, these agencies must cooperate with Congress, providing the transparency needed to deliver the answers the American people deserve.

2.title: House Bipartisan Task Force Outlines Secret Service's Failure to Execute
2.description: The Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump is the official bipartisan task force of the U.S. House of Representatives investigating the assassination attempts of the President-elect in Butler, Pa. and West Palm Beach, Fla. The Task Force's final report, submitted to Congress in December 2024, outlined critical structural and procedural failures at the July 13 rally that almost cost President-elect Trump his life. This video is the second in a series of three videos detailing the Task Force's investigation and final report.

3.title: House Bipartisan Task Force Outlines Secret Service's Failure to Plan
3.description:
The Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump is the official bipartisan task force of the U.S. House of Representatives investigating the assassination attempts of the President-elect in Butler, Pa. and West Palm Beach, Fla. The Task Force's final report, submitted to Congress in December 2024, outlined clear missteps in the planning of the July 13 rally that almost cost President-elect Trump his life.

This video is the first in a series of three videos detailing the Task Force's investigation and final report.

Full report: https://taskforce.house.gov/media-center/press-releases/final-report-task-force-concludes-its-investigation-releases-report
Learn more: https://taskforce.house.gov/
